forecast_origin_note: latest source CPI observation; final release vintages are not available
exogenous_availability: Baseline FRED controls and Pink Sheet monthly commodity indices are lagged one month; WPI YoY is lagged four months; latest WPI input observation is 2026-04. SARIMAX holds the last known lagged external vector constant over the forecast horizon.
target_definition: India CPI Combined General Group inflation YoY; official MoSPI 2024-base back/current series; 2025 YoY derived from same-base index levels.
validation_note: Targets >=2024-01 were used as a model-comparison period; feature specifications were compared on the same period, so it is not a final untouched holdout.
